description: Memory leak in ISR due to allocation without free
user_question: Is there a memory issue in this ISR code?
expected_root_cause: malloc in ISR without corresponding free - memory leaks on each interrupt
expected_fix: Add free(buffer) before function returns; avoid malloc in ISR - use static buffer instead

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Add free(buffer); better: use static buffer in ISR to avoid allocation

expected_follow_up_required: Avoid dynamic allocation in ISRs entirely - use pre-allocated buffers
